plain: To sell at a lower price than competitors

webster.text: To sell the same articles at a lower price than another.

example.quote: Duties of this nature evidently amount to a virtual bounty on the domestic fabrics, since by enhancing the charges on foreign articles they enable the national manufacturers to undersell all their foreign competitors.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures (communicated to the House of Representatives, Dec. 5, 1791)
